review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer - Firewall Engineering
review_candidates.description: Requisition Id 17051 Overview Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) is currently seeking qualified applicants to serve as a Senior Network Engineer supporting unclassified operations. The successful candidate will possess advanced knowledge of network engineering, firewall architecture, network security policy, enterprise network design, and the interactions among complex information systems. This position will emphasize the engineering, architecture, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise firewall services. The candidate will collaborate with teams across the laboratory, including Enterprise Networking, Information Technology, the Classification Office, Cybersecurity, Laboratory Enterprise Risk, Internal Audit, and other organizations as appropriate. The Senior Network Engineer will assist Enterprise Networking in developing secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that support the laboratory’s long-term growth. The engineer will evaluate complex technical and security requirements and develop enterprise-class network and firewall solutions that improve service availability, operational efficiency, and ORNL’s overall cybersecurity posture. The position requires the ability to apply industry standards and government security requirements within ORNL’s environment. The engineer will serve as a technical leader and subject-matter expert for firewall architecture. Major Duties/Responsibilities Work with multiple divisions within ORNL’s Information Technology Directorate to design, implement, maintain, and improve complex information systems that comply with U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), other applicable government, and local cybersecurity policies. Evaluate how existing information systems integrate with one another and determine how new technologies can be securely incorporated into the enterprise environment. Develop solutions that balance cybersecurity, availability, performance, maintainability, and mission requirements. Design and maintain enterprise firewall architectures supporting campus, data center, internet-edge, remote-access, and segmented network environments. Serve as a subject-matter expert for firewalls, firewall management, VPN clients, and associated security services. Translate business, mission, technical, and cybersecurity requirements into secure firewall designs and implementation plans. Lead firewall deployments, migrations, upgrades, hardware refreshes, policy conversions, and platform-standardization initiatives. Troubleshoot complex connectivity, routing, application, performance, high-availability, and security-policy issues across multiple network and system layers. Monitor firewall capacity, system health, software lifecycle status, security advisories, and emerging threats; recommend upgrades or architectural changes when appropriate. Participate in scheduled maintenance activities and provide escalation or on-call support for critical network-security services as required. Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success. Basic Qualifications BS degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related discipline, with 8 years of professional experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Significant experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network and firewall environments. Advanced hands-on experience with Next-Gen firewalls and centralized management. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, subnetting, routing, switching, network segmentation, access control, NAT, VPN technologies, and high-availability design. Knowledge of network-security architecture, defense-in-depth, least privilege, zero trust, and secure network-design principles. Experience working within structured change-control, configuration-management, and incident-management processes. Preferred Qualifications Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to work independently, lead complex technical efforts, and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries. Experience with Palo Alto Networks technologies such as GlobalProtect, Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced URL Filtering, WildFire, DNS Security, User-ID, App-ID, and SSL/TLS decryption. Experience managing large or distributed Palo Alto firewall environments using Panorama templates, template stacks, device groups, and policy hierarchy. Experience integrating firewalls with identity and authentication technologies such as Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, multifactor authentication, and certificate-based authentication. Experience with network automation and configuration management using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, or similar technologies. Familiarity with public- or private-cloud networking and security, including Palo Alto VM-Series or cloud-native firewall integrations. Experience working in a federal government, DOE, national laboratory, research, critical-infrastructure, or similarly regulated environment. Familiarity with applicable security frameworks and guidance, including NIST publications, federal cybersecurity requirements, and security control assessment processes. Relevant certifications such as Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer, Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect, Cisco Certified Network Professional, or comparable credentials. Special Requirements Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Security, Credentialing, Eligibility Requirements: Q Clearance: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. Hybrid Eligibility: For Hybrid eligible positions: In addition, we offer a flexible work environment that supports both the organization and the employee. A hybrid/onsite working arrangement may be available with this position. About ORNL As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience. Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts. This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired. We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment. If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov. ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

review_candidates.title: Sr Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Sr. Network Engineer The Sr. Network Engineer partners with other engineering teams and Enterprise Architects to design, deploy, manage, and operate a large enterprise network. The infrastructure consists of a mix of network switches, routers, wireless access points, firewalls, load balancers and cloud network/application services. The Sr. Network Engineer operates and maintains some or all these components while ensuring an uptime of 99.9%. This position will play a lead role supporting projects, enhancing automation, performing technology evaluations, deploying Network technologies, and will be tasked with the day-to-day operation of Lennar network infrastructure. In addition, this role will participate on process improvement, operational excellence, AI transformation, design, and standardization. Your Responsibilities On The Team Functions in a customer-facing role and therefore is expected to be approachable and service minded. Provides Tier 3 engineering support during critical operational incidents as necessary. Maintains current network infrastructure and leverages the manufacturer for advanced support. Maintains high network availability for redundancy and resilience. Understands and accounts for peak load; manages peak load events. Follows industry best practices, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for operational efficiency. Optimizes, implements and monitors network performance. Maintains and reacts to Enterprise-grade network monitoring system. Works with automation tools and platforms such as GitHub, HashiCorp, and coding languages like Python, Terraform, Ansible to build automation workflows and increase efficiency. Supports the deployment of network equipment for new office build outs. Oversees the order and deployment of WAN circuits, including MPLS, DIA, Broadbands, VPN's and point-to-point circuits. Supports the LAN wired and wireless infrastructure. Deploys, operates and maintains F5 load balancing LTM and APM modules. Works closely with Enterprise Security Office to implement reliable, manageable, and secure solutions that meet Network/Security Industry standards. Assists in the deployment of Palo Alto SD-WAN and SASE (Prisma SD-WAN). Performs security audits of the network system and improves the security posture. Assists with disaster recovery setups, both on a global and site-by-site basis. Performs network technologies evaluation. Writes technical documentation, including architecture decision records, network diagrams, policies and procedures. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering or related field; or equivalent work experience. Certifications such as ITIL, Cisco CCNP, or similar are preferred but not required. 5+ years relevant work experience Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements: This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. 10-20% of travel is required. Additional Requirements: Must be self-motivated with strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills. The ability to work effectively with clients, management, and staff members in a multi-tiered, fast-paced environment. Experience working in previous large Enterprise Network Engineering role desired. Ability to translate technical recommendations into a visual format for presentation to non-technical stakeholders. Experience with automation tools and CI/CD principles. Proficient with Palo Alto SD-WAN and SASE (Prisma SD-WAN). Expert with Cisco Meraki Networks, Catalyst and Nexus network switches, F5 load balancers LTM abd APM products, Cisco ISR and ASR routers. Knowledge of IP fundamentals, DNS, DHCP, and IPv4/IPv6. Knowledge and expertise in Wireless LAN technologies. Must demonstrate in-depth understanding of the OSI model. Demonstrable knowledge in the design, implementation, troubleshooting and operations of data center technologies. Firm understanding of operating systems, virtualization, network services for cloud enablement, and security. Consistently able to solve connectivity problems to increase bandwidth, improve response times, maximize performance, and support global operations. Extensive skills in WAN related architectures and technologies important to enterprises, such as MPLS, hybrid environments connectivity, IPsec and emerging technologies. This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Knowledge of SDWAN technologies Expert with F5 products Life at Lennar At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities. Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Apply

review_candidates.title: Principal Cisco Network Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Cisco Network Engineer will be responsible for design, deployment, testing, certification, patching, and addressing interoperability issues for all features, components, and application dependencies. To include switches, firewalls, load balancers, software defined networking, private cloud requirements, etc. This is onsite in Pocatello, ID and a current Top Secret clearance is required to be considered for an interview. We’re basically looking for an Enterprise Network Engineer with 6+ years’ experience, who has or is willing to get a CCNA, with a preference on Application-Centric Infrastructure (ACI) and Network Services Orchestrator (NSO) experience. We are hiring onsite in Pocatello, ID (Preferred) and Huntsville . You must be willing to work onsite and have a current Top Secret clearance in order to be considered. Responsibilities Design, implementation and ongoing support of the Networking Infrastructure within and between data centers. Serve as the advanced matter expert for all data center network environments. Create and maintain network infrastructure for both bare-metal and virtual machines with the appropriate LAN, WAN, vLAN, SDN, firewall and load balancer configurations, using both OEM and third-party tools that include virtual network tools (NSX) and services. Provision/configure the required networking for servers and applications. Evaluate, improve, and maintain the information security throughout the data center network infrastructure. Monitor and correct network issues and create recovery processes for failures and performance bottlenecks. Provide real time alerts for network problem issues and implement proactive solutions for future problems to include re-design or tech refresh. Install, configure, test, and maintain system management tools for all data center network components. Write and maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks, such as automated provisioning of addresses and VLANS with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS). Provide 4th level support. Ensure technical documentation exists for all systems and is kept up to date to include inventory and patch levels of all systems to include hostnames, property numbers, IP addresses, enclave, number of cores, number of processors, admin passwords, certificates, and service accounts on a monthly interval. Qualifications Must have an active and current Top Secret clearance at time of submitting application. Cisco Certified Design Professional (CCDP), or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or DevNet Associate certifications. Bachelor’s degree preferred Six years of experience required. Experience with Application-Centric Infrastructure (ACI), Tetration, Multi-Site-Orchestrator (MSO), Network Assurance Engine (NAE), Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), Nexus Insights, and Digital Network Architecture Center (DNAC) is preferred. About Us: Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services, and timely delivery. Edgewater Federal Solutions is ISO 9001, 20000-1, 270001 certified, appraised at CMMI Level 3 Maturity for Development and Services, and has been named in the Top Workplaces in the Greater Washington Area Small Companies for 2018 through 2025. It has been and continues to be the policy of Edgewater Federal Solutions to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, and/or other statuses protected by applicable law.

review_candidates.title: Cloud Networking & Infrastructure Developer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview: For more than 50 years, NISC has developed and implemented enterprise-level and customer-facing software solutions for over 1,200+ utilities and broadbands across North America. Our mission is to deliver technology solutions and services that are Member-focused, quality driven and valued priced. We exist to serve our Members and help them serve their communities through our innovative software products, services and outstanding customer support. NISC has been ranked in ComputerWorld's Best Places to Work for twenty-two years, and we are looking for qualified individuals to join our team. Our Members have over 18 million end customers (residential and businesses who receive power, internet, television and/or telephone services) that our enterprise software solution enables our Members to compete effectively in the industry, while excelling in customer service. Position Overview: Ready to grow your career with a company that's moving fast and going places? NISC is looking for driven talent to join our Platform & Infrastructure division and help keep our network infrastructure running strong — and secure. As part of the Cloud Networking team, you'll work alongside a skilled group dedicated to building resilient, highly available network solutions and keeping our members' services running smoothly day in and day out. Security is built into everything we do — you'll help design and maintain solutions that protect our members' data and keep our network defenses strong, without losing sight of speed and reliability. We're looking for people who thrive on learning new technologies, take pride in delivering top-notch service to the members we support, and build with security in mind from the start. If you're ready for a role where no two days look the same and your work truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. Work Schedule: Hybrid from one of our office locations: Atlanta, GA Cedar Rapids, IA Lake Saint Louis, MO Mandan, ND Hybrid Schedule: Minimum of working 3 day per week out of an office location and ability to work up to all 5 days a week from an office location. Required Days from an Office Location: Tuesday and Wednesday - the third required day will be up to the candidate and their supervisor to choose. Essential Duties: Build KPI dashboards that track networking and application response time SLAs Lead design and development of low-latency infrastructure for distributed systems Lead hybrid cloud network topology design and build using industry best practices Lead design and build of containerized network topologies Manage key vendor relationships and drive internet connectivity strategy Advise on vulnerability best practices and own resolution Design and automate network patching aligned with our Vulnerability Management Policy Develop maintenance plans and coordinate cross-team impacts and best practices Maintain documentation, SOPs, and our knowledge base Perform compliance audits Own a cost-control budget for public cloud resource usage Leverage generative AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, creativity, and problem-solving within the scope of the role Participate in on-call rotation (evenings/weekends) and occasional after-hours maintenance May be requested to mentor other team members Commitment to NISC's Statement of Shared Values Other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Preferred: 1-5 years of related experience in networking, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, software development, or a related technical field. Knowledge of networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ARP, NTP, OSPF, BGP, VPNs, and network security fundamentals. Experience with or exposure to networking platforms such as Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall, Arista Networks, Extreme Networks, or similar technologies. Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line administration. Experience developing scripts or applications using Python, Java, PowerShell, or other programming languages. Familiarity with infrastructure automation concepts and tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. Basic understanding of cloud networking concepts and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Knowledge of containers and container orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of high availability, redundancy, load balancing, and disaster recovery concepts. Exposure to monitoring, logging, and observability tools. Knowledge of firewall administration, network segmentation, and VPN technologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment while managing multiple priorities. Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and a desire for continuous learning. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to travel as necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the position. NISC's Shared Values & Competencies: Integrity – We are committed to doing the right thing – always. Relationships – We are committed to building and preserving lasting relationships. Innovation – We promote the spirit of creativity and champion new ideas. Teamwork – We exemplify the cooperative spirit by working together. Empowerment – We believe individuals have the power to make a difference. Personal Development – We believe the free exchange of knowledge and information is absolutely necessary to the success of each individual and the organization. Benefits: Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance. Health Savings Account (HSA) with $100 monthly contributions from NISC. Like to walk? Improve your overall wellness knowledge? Ability to earn up to $800 additional dollars into your HSA each year through our Wellness Rewards program. Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) thru Paylocity. Fully covered life insurance up to x3 annual base salary. Fully covered short- and long-term disability. 401(k), traditional or Roth, with employee match up to 6% and employer 4% salary base contributions. PTO accrual levels dependent on years of service, 120 Life Leave Event hours, 9 paid holidays and an annual holiday week. $2,500 Interest-FREE technology loan program. $25,000 employee educational assistance program. Volunteer, Wellness, Family Events and other employee fun supplied by our committees. Employee Assistance Program; assisting employees and dependents with virtually any life event Benevolence Committee to support employees with financial hardships like unexpected medical bills, funerals and other unfortunate hardships. Education Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Networking, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, a business-related field or equivalent experience. Other Qualifications/Certifications Preferred: Certification in Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other public cloud technology. Industry recognized certifications are a plus. Minimum Physical Requirements: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the essential functions of this position, employees must be able to see and communicate. Employees are regularly required to maintain a stationary position, move, and operate computer keyboards or office equipment. Disclaimer: Management may modify this job description by assigning or reassigning duties and responsibilities at any time. Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI. 📐 About The Role At WRITER, our mission to expand human capacity with superintelligence relies on a foundational truth: our platform must be available, performant, and reliable, 24/7. As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need. This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What You'll Do Technical Breadth across disciplines. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. This is not a thrash-every-week role — most of the time you're heads-down on one substantial initiative (the on-call posture, the release pipeline, the multi-region Terraform layout, the internal platform surface). Cross-layer fluency is what lets you pick the right next initiative; it isn't a weekly context-switch. Simplicity / via negativa. Challenge the status quo and remove toil before adding features — automate operational tasks and infrastructure management with Python or Go, reject tools that don't fit the problem, and treat manual on-call work as a defect to be designed out, not a status quo to be staffed up. Breadth across the stack. Design scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure across AWS (preferred), GCP, and Azure, working fluently across Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and the supporting cloud and AI tooling that backs WRITER's high-traffic platform. AI in workflow. Run agents in your daily loop — Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills — to investigate incidents, draft Terraform / Helm changes, write runbooks, scaffold tooling, and review PRs. Build the agentic setup as a collective surface: humans and digital teammates working as one team, with shared skills, shared context, and shared on-call workflows. Encode recurring infra tasks as internal skills any teammate (human or agent) can pick up and run, so the team's throughput compounds — not just your own. Debugging fluency. Lead incident response, post-mortems, and root-cause analyses — trace failures to the underlying problem (never the symptom), apply the learning back into the architecture, and prevent the same incident from happening twice. Non-technical End-to-end ownership. Own the reliability, performance, and efficiency of WRITER's core services end-to-end — define and uphold the SLOs and error budgets, carry the on-call pager, and stand behind the outcome metric, not just the system you shipped. Strategic vs. tactical balance. Balance this week's critical work with the 6–12-month platform direction — ship the on-call-driving fix today while shaping the multi-year observability, cost, and reliability investments that move WRITER's enterprise customers. Cross-functional collaboration. Operate at the seams with product, security, and engineering peers — provide expert guidance on system design for reliability, performance, and scalability from conception through launch, Connect the infra agenda to product and revenue context, and disagree with evidence, not volume. ⭐️ What You Need Technical Track record. 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a similar role focused on building and operating large-scale, high-availability production systems at a high-growth product company. Breadth. Experience running containerisation in production (a real cluster, not a lab), with experience in Helm and Terraform or Pulumi on at least one major cloud (AWS preferred), plus good proficiency in Python or Go for automation and tooling. AI in workflow. AI is part of how you ship, not a thing you've read about — agentic tooling (Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills) is in your daily loop, you've built or adopted AI-assisted workflows others now use, and you have strong opinions on where it's unreliable. This is a hard requirement, not a bonus. Candidates whose actual daily workflow does not already include AI tooling will not be advanced. First-principles + decision-making. Demonstrated ability to Challenge the status quo, proactively identify systemic weaknesses, and propose innovative solutions to complex reliability problems — reason from constraints and failure modes (not analogy or vendor defaults), name the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off), and reject the "best practices" answer when it doesn't fit the problem. Reversibility & blast-radius. Make reversible calls by default — write the rollback before you touch production, work fluently with monitoring and logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or equivalent), and stress the system in safe places so it comes back stronger. Non-technical Cross-functional collaboration. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a talent for building strong relationships and Connecting with cross-functional teams — surface non-goals before anyone asks, and partner with product, security, and platform peers as one delivery surface. Autonomy & end-to-end ownership. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, eager to Own mission-critical systems and drive them toward peak performance and unparalleled reliability. At least one 0-to-1 infrastructure build you owned end-to-end, with the outcome metric attached. 🎁 Bonus if you have Software-engineering depth. A software-engineering background, not only config and scripting — you've designed, built, and shipped non-trivial production code (services, libraries, internal frameworks) in Python, Go, or a comparable language, you can read and modify the codebases your infrastructure runs, and you move between infra automation and feature engineering without changing brains. 🍩 Benefits & Perks (UK Full-time Employees) Generous PTO, plus company holidays Comprehensive medical and dental insurance Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) Fertility and family planning support Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri Competitive pension scheme and company contribution Annual work-life stipends for: Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. Learning and development stipend Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites Competitive compensation and company stock options

Support hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) platforms, assisting with capacity planning, performance troubleshooting, and lifecycle activities. Support cloud‑native compute platforms including Google Compute Engine (GCE) for Citrix‑hosted and supporting workloads. Support maintenance activities, upgrades, patching, DR testing, and planned change events. Perform other duties as assigned. Working knowledge of hybrid infrastructure operations across cloud and on‑prem platforms. Experience supporting VMware virtualization (vCenter / ESXi) in production environments. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience. review_candidates.title: Data Center Administrator
review_candidates.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. DATA CENTER ADMIN ISTRATOR SpaceX is looking for a data center administrator to help us build and manage our data center infrastructure. As part of our infrastructure team, your responsibility will be the proficient installation and management of server, network, and power systems in our data centers, adhering to best practices to ensure optimal performance. The ideal candidate has experience working with various types of hardware architectures and understands the strengths of each. You will also carry out performance-tuning and quality assurance operations on critical infrastructure components to ensure high level of data quality, availability, and security across the enterprise. In fulfilling this role, you will be expected to collaborate with the team to develop and implement strategies for improved data center operations. Responsibilities Resolve operational, infrastructure or hardware incidents in multiple data centers. Manage complete lifecycle for data center hardware, including deployment, operation, and decommission. Physically rack and cable data center equipment. Track and logically organize the physical storage of incoming data center equipment. Perform quality assurance testing and resolve recurring issues. Schedule and track hardware maintenance tasks. Update port maps and rack layouts and create operational procedures. Monitor the environmental conditions and power/cooling systems of a data center to ensure they are optimum for servers, switches, storage arrays, and other devices. Run hardware diagnostics and replace failing parts in a timely manner. Upgrade internal system components, including CPUs, memory, and storage. Setup and operate common Linux and Windows servers. Document processes and keep event logs. Work with the purchasing department on the procurement of new data center equipment. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline and 1+ year of data center experience; OR 3+ years of data center experience in lieu of a degree. Professional experience working in a data center or with IT hardware. Preferred Skills And Experience Certifications related to IT infrastructure such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Network+, and CCNP. Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM), including tools to monitor, measure, manage, and/or control data center utilization. In-depth knowledge of data center environments, servers, and network equipment. Extensive experience in installing, monitoring, and maintaining data center equipment. Linux and Windows OS system administration experience. Power and data center cooling capacity planning experience. Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills. Experience working with multiple vendor hardware architectures. Experience working with server management tools such as HPE iLO, Cisco CIMC and Dell iDRAC. Additional Requirements Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed (to respond to network and server errors after hours). Compensation And Benefits Pay Range: Level 1: $95,000.00 - $125,000.00 Level 2: $115,000.00 - $155,000.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ETS also delivers all workplace technologies (desktop, mobile, voice, video, productivity, intranet/internet) in integrated configurations that boost the personal productivity of employees. Ability to perform problem determination, dump analysis and performance tuning Knowledge of Cobol to support application developers Experience with Mainframe Websphere MQ Excellent oral/written communication skills Skills Desired Assembler, COBOL and REXX coding and knowledge of CICS Exits Web application support in a CICS TS V6.x environment Understanding of zOS facilities such as: APF, Linklist, VSAM, LPA, RLS, Coupling Facility Utilization of CICS Configuration Manager Working knowledge of zOS & CICS Explorer Understanding of CICS REST Services Prior Application programming experience a plus. A Day in the Life We’re looking for a Staff Engineer DevOps to join our Platform Engineering & Operations team as a hands-on individual-contributor engineer, helping to build and maintain the infrastructure underneath Lendistry’s lending platform. You’ll work on cloud architecture, security posture, and developer experience across a regulated financial services environment — and help support fellow engineers so we can grow without compromising reliability or compliance. Lendistry: Who We Are We’re proud to be the nation’s largest minority-led, tech-savvy lender for small businesses and commercial real estate. As a certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and Community Development Entity (CDE), our mission is all about creating economic opportunities and fueling growth for small business owners and their communities. Join us as we pave the way with innovative financing and financial education! What You’ll Be Doing Collaboration & Mentorship Work as a hands-on individual contributor engineer on the Platform Engineering & Operations team, without formal people-management responsibilities. Help mentor junior engineers on the team, sharing knowledge as they grow their skills. Provide input and feedback on the technical roadmap for infrastructure and platform engineering. Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Support cloud architecture and account management across development, staging, and production environments for a regulated lending platform. Help implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices across infrastructure operations. Support container orchestration across multiple deployable services and cloud accounts. Security, Identity & Compliance Support identity management, account-level security posture, secrets management, and KMS key practices. Assist security and compliance teams with audits and vendor/security assessments for a regulated financial services platform. Developer Experience & CI/CD Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines across multiple repositories, from build through environment-gated production deployments. Support developer experience and internal tooling improvements for engineering teams. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in on-call and incident-response practices, including postmortems, for a platform where downtime directly impacts loan funding and servicing. AI-Native Platform Engineering Explore and help integrate AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into infrastructure workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and internal tooling. Support the adoption of AI-driven observability practices — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis — layered on top of existing monitoring stacks. Help support the infrastructure needs of ML/AI-driven product features (e.g., underwriting and fraud models), including model serving, inference monitoring, and compute scaling for AI workloads. Contribute to self-service internal tooling and golden paths that make it easier for engineers to ship safely. Your Areas of Knowledge and Expertise Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. 4+ years of experience engineering highly available, enterprise-grade software and platform applications. 2+ years of hands-on experience in platform engineering across various cloud computing models. 2+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, Docker, and cloud-native applications. Substantial hands-on experience with public cloud platform services such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. Hands-on coding experience in at least two programming languages (Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, or .NET/C#). Experience with cloud-native application patterns and tools, microservices architectures, and application migrations to any cloud platform. Working understanding of infrastructure, virtualization, containers, networking, storage, and monitoring and logging/analytics tools (e.g., Splunk). Experience with application performance management tools (Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, etc.). Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and processes (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Ansible). Experience with developer tools and open-source technologies. Working familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps concepts and the infrastructure needs of AI/ML workloads (GPU or accelerator provisioning, model serving, inference cost and latency management). Hands-on use of AI coding assistants and developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in real engineering workflows. Familiarity with policy-as-code (e.g., OPA, Kyverno) and software supply chain security practices (SBOM generation, artifact signing/provenance) as applied to CI/CD pipelines. Preferred Expertise 2+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with hands-on experience in AWS production environments. Experience supporting cloud platforms aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework, with an interest in security, reliability, operational excellence, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. Hands-on experience with AWS core services, including VPC, EC2, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, S3, networking, security services, and container orchestration platforms such as Amazon EKS or ECS. Experience working with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or AWS CloudFormation. Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins. Experience with cloud operations, including platform administration, production support, capacity planning, patching, and maintenance for AWS environments. They provide effective production support including accurate problem identification, ticket documentation and customer/vendor dialogue. Duties And Responsibilities Own and deliver automation and scripting of Oracle database activities and admin projects. Ensure the optimal performance and high availability of database systems and services while meeting or exceeding our Service Level Objectives. Work with multiple technology teams and facilitate collaboration across Development, Operational and non-technical stakeholders. Provide technical leadership for large and/or complex business efforts. Serve as a technical expert on efficiency practices around databases and especially the Oracle Database platform that will drive optimal technology utilization. Serve as a technical expert in HA, DR, Security, Database Installations and Database troubleshooting. Support implementation of new releases of DBMS software; plan and implement new features where appropriate. Work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly develop proficiency in new skills. Think and act proactively and creatively in identifying opportunities in team's daily work along with executing and completing tasks that are highly visible. Adopt and embrace automation practices across the various technical platforms and domains. Perform other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline, or 5+ additional years of equivalent experience. 3-5+ years of experience as an Oracle Database Administrator. Preferred Qualifications Advanced working knowledge and understanding of Oracle 19c to current Advanced working knowledge of Oracle Server security and general DB security practices including RBAC. Advanced skills in Data Guard technologies. Professional experience with RAC and Exadata is preferred. Unix Scripting (KSH/BASH). Advanced Unix Server experience. Advanced SQL skills including use and optimization techniques. Proven ability to lead directly and in-directly with direct team and across teams. High level knowledge of key business drivers measures, processes and challenges. Strong collaboration skills and ability to promote ideas and advocate for change. Good overall exposure to various technology stacks like Storage, Network, OS and databases. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code and Desired State Configuration. review_candidates.title: Lead Mainframe z/OS Db2 SRE
review_candidates.description: When you join MetLife’s Global Technology team, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking group dedicated to shaping the future of digital solutions for customers worldwide. You’ll develop, maintain and support technology applications and delivery, leveraging AI, automation, and contemporary ways of working to enhance experiences and drive business outcomes. Your work will simplify complex processes, improve tech resiliency, and ensure high-performing, seamless solutions that power life’s most important moments. In this dynamic environment, you’ll collaborate with talented peers across teams and functions, expanding your skills in impactful ways. Ready to push boundaries and set new industry standards? Join us and help drive the future of technology forward. The Opportunity MetLife is seeking a highly skilled and forward-thinking Lead Mainframe z/OS Db2 Site Reliability Engineer to join our dynamic Mainframe & Integration Technology team. In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise to bridge the gap between the reliability of legacy systems and the demands of future-ready solutions, driving the modernization and optimization of our mainframe platforms. In this leadership position, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and directing the modernization and optimization of MetLife's mainframe database systems to ensure they are reliable, scalable, and fully aligned with our evolving business goals. Design and assist in the automation of Mainframe resilience, BCP tests and the recovery of data from safe guarded copies. The ideal candidate will bring extensive expertise in mainframe technologies, a strategic vision for IT transformation, and a proven history of successfully leading complex, enterprise-wide mainframe modernization projects. Key Responsibilities Assist in leading the architecture, design, and implementation of mainframe solutions that support MetLife's business goals and technology strategy. Provide technical leadership and guidance to mainframe development, operations, and modernization teams. Collaborate with business stakeholders, application developers, and infrastructure teams to identify requirements and deliver innovative, cost-effective mainframe solutions. Help establish a new Mainframe in-take and change processes that consider new workloads and provide required mainframe performance tuning of z/OS Db2 subsystems and z/OS Db2 databases. Assist in developing self-service on-demand automation for DDL and DML requests. Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies to drive continuous improvement and modernization of mainframe platforms, including CI/CD pipelines to deploy database changes. Establish and enforce best practices, standards, and architectural governance for mainframe environments. Develop and maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps, and blueprints for mainframe systems. Ensure high availability, security, and performance of z/OS Db2 subsystems and database by constantly reviewing relevant SMF & RMF performance telemetry data and appropriate application traces with application stakeholders and suggesting SQL statement improvements and physical database design changes. Participate in ITSM processes such as Release/Change approvals, Incident/Problem resolution. Proven experience resolving z/OS Db2 related incidents during troubleshooting Partner with enterprise architects and other technology leaders to define and implement enterprise-wide technology strategies. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related field experience. 7+ years of experience in mainframe engineering, with strong experience in service delivery, engineering, or architecture. Expertise in IBM z/OS Db2 and related mainframe technologies. Demonstrated experience with mainframe modernization, integration, and migration projects. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. Analytical, strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud integration, DevOps, zLinux, OpenShift and automation in mainframe environments. (RedHat Ansible for IBM Z Collections, Ansible, Python) Knowledge of hybrid IT architectures and emerging technology trends. Relevant certifications (e.g., IBM Certified System Architect, TOGAF). Experience in the insurance or financial services industry. Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role r equiring a minimum of 3 days per week in office. The expected salary range for this position is $111,000 - $180,000. This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation and stock-based long-term incentives. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms. Benefits We Offer Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here. About MetLife Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value. Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. new_matches.description: The Cisco Network Engineer will be responsible for design, deployment, testing, certification, patching, and addressing interoperability issues for all features, components, and application dependencies. To include switches, firewalls, load balancers, software defined networking, private cloud requirements, etc. This is onsite in Pocatello, ID and a current Top Secret clearance is required to be considered for an interview. We’re basically looking for an Enterprise Network Engineer with 6+ years’ experience, who has or is willing to get a CCNA, with a preference on Application-Centric Infrastructure (ACI) and Network Services Orchestrator (NSO) experience. We are hiring onsite in Pocatello, ID (Preferred) and Huntsville . You must be willing to work onsite and have a current Top Secret clearance in order to be considered. Responsibilities Design, implementation and ongoing support of the Networking Infrastructure within and between data centers. Serve as the advanced matter expert for all data center network environments. Create and maintain network infrastructure for both bare-metal and virtual machines with the appropriate LAN, WAN, vLAN, SDN, firewall and load balancer configurations, using both OEM and third-party tools that include virtual network tools (NSX) and services. Provision/configure the required networking for servers and applications. Evaluate, improve, and maintain the information security throughout the data center network infrastructure. Monitor and correct network issues and create recovery processes for failures and performance bottlenecks. Provide real time alerts for network problem issues and implement proactive solutions for future problems to include re-design or tech refresh. Install, configure, test, and maintain system management tools for all data center network components. Write and maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks, such as automated provisioning of addresses and VLANS with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS). Provide 4th level support. Ensure technical documentation exists for all systems and is kept up to date to include inventory and patch levels of all systems to include hostnames, property numbers, IP addresses, enclave, number of cores, number of processors, admin passwords, certificates, and service accounts on a monthly interval. Qualifications Must have an active and current Top Secret clearance at time of submitting application. Cisco Certified Design Professional (CCDP), or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or DevNet Associate certifications. Bachelor’s degree preferred Six years of experience required. Experience with Application-Centric Infrastructure (ACI), Tetration, Multi-Site-Orchestrator (MSO), Network Assurance Engine (NAE), Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), Nexus Insights, and Digital Network Architecture Center (DNAC) is preferred. new_matches.description: Company Overview: For more than 50 years, NISC has developed and implemented enterprise-level and customer-facing software solutions for over 1,200+ utilities and broadbands across North America. Our mission is to deliver technology solutions and services that are Member-focused, quality driven and valued priced. We exist to serve our Members and help them serve their communities through our innovative software products, services and outstanding customer support. NISC has been ranked in ComputerWorld's Best Places to Work for twenty-two years, and we are looking for qualified individuals to join our team. Our Members have over 18 million end customers (residential and businesses who receive power, internet, television and/or telephone services) that our enterprise software solution enables our Members to compete effectively in the industry, while excelling in customer service. Position Overview: Ready to grow your career with a company that's moving fast and going places? NISC is looking for driven talent to join our Platform & Infrastructure division and help keep our network infrastructure running strong — and secure. As part of the Cloud Networking team, you'll work alongside a skilled group dedicated to building resilient, highly available network solutions and keeping our members' services running smoothly day in and day out. Security is built into everything we do — you'll help design and maintain solutions that protect our members' data and keep our network defenses strong, without losing sight of speed and reliability. We're looking for people who thrive on learning new technologies, take pride in delivering top-notch service to the members we support, and build with security in mind from the start. If you're ready for a role where no two days look the same and your work truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. Work Schedule: Hybrid from one of our office locations: Atlanta, GA Cedar Rapids, IA Lake Saint Louis, MO Mandan, ND Hybrid Schedule: Minimum of working 3 day per week out of an office location and ability to work up to all 5 days a week from an office location. Required Days from an Office Location: Tuesday and Wednesday - the third required day will be up to the candidate and their supervisor to choose. Essential Duties: Build KPI dashboards that track networking and application response time SLAs Lead design and development of low-latency infrastructure for distributed systems Lead hybrid cloud network topology design and build using industry best practices Lead design and build of containerized network topologies Manage key vendor relationships and drive internet connectivity strategy Advise on vulnerability best practices and own resolution Design and automate network patching aligned with our Vulnerability Management Policy Develop maintenance plans and coordinate cross-team impacts and best practices Maintain documentation, SOPs, and our knowledge base Perform compliance audits Own a cost-control budget for public cloud resource usage Leverage generative AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, creativity, and problem-solving within the scope of the role Participate in on-call rotation (evenings/weekends) and occasional after-hours maintenance May be requested to mentor other team members Commitment to NISC's Statement of Shared Values Other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Preferred: 1-5 years of related experience in networking, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, software development, or a related technical field. Knowledge of networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ARP, NTP, OSPF, BGP, VPNs, and network security fundamentals. Experience with or exposure to networking platforms such as Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall, Arista Networks, Extreme Networks, or similar technologies. Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line administration. Experience developing scripts or applications using Python, Java, PowerShell, or other programming languages. Familiarity with infrastructure automation concepts and tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. Basic understanding of cloud networking concepts and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Knowledge of containers and container orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of high availability, redundancy, load balancing, and disaster recovery concepts. Exposure to monitoring, logging, and observability tools. Knowledge of firewall administration, network segmentation, and VPN technologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment while managing multiple priorities. Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and a desire for continuous learning. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to travel as necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the position. NISC's Shared Values & Competencies: Integrity – We are committed to doing the right thing – always. Relationships – We are committed to building and preserving lasting relationships. Innovation – We promote the spirit of creativity and champion new ideas. Teamwork – We exemplify the cooperative spirit by working together. Empowerment – We believe individuals have the power to make a difference. Personal Development – We believe the free exchange of knowledge and information is absolutely necessary to the success of each individual and the organization. Benefits: Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance. Health Savings Account (HSA) with $100 monthly contributions from NISC. Like to walk? Improve your overall wellness knowledge? Ability to earn up to $800 additional dollars into your HSA each year through our Wellness Rewards program. Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) thru Paylocity. Fully covered life insurance up to x3 annual base salary. Fully covered short- and long-term disability. 401(k), traditional or Roth, with employee match up to 6% and employer 4% salary base contributions. PTO accrual levels dependent on years of service, 120 Life Leave Event hours, 9 paid holidays and an annual holiday week. $2,500 Interest-FREE technology loan program. $25,000 employee educational assistance program. Volunteer, Wellness, Family Events and other employee fun supplied by our committees. Employee Assistance Program; assisting employees and dependents with virtually any life event Benevolence Committee to support employees with financial hardships like unexpected medical bills, funerals and other unfortunate hardships. Education Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Networking, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, a business-related field or equivalent experience. Other Qualifications/Certifications Preferred: Certification in Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other public cloud technology. Industry recognized certifications are a plus. Minimum Physical Requirements: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the essential functions of this position, employees must be able to see and communicate. Employees are regularly required to maintain a stationary position, move, and operate computer keyboards or office equipment. new_matches.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI. Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI. 📐 About The Role At WRITER, our mission to expand human capacity with superintelligence relies on a foundational truth: our platform must be available, performant, and reliable, 24/7. As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need. This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What You'll Do Technical Breadth across disciplines. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. This is not a thrash-every-week role — most of the time you're heads-down on one substantial initiative (the on-call posture, the release pipeline, the multi-region Terraform layout, the internal platform surface). Cross-layer fluency is what lets you pick the right next initiative; it isn't a weekly context-switch. Simplicity / via negativa. Challenge the status quo and remove toil before adding features — automate operational tasks and infrastructure management with Python or Go, reject tools that don't fit the problem, and treat manual on-call work as a defect to be designed out, not a status quo to be staffed up. Breadth across the stack. Design scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure across AWS (preferred), GCP, and Azure, working fluently across Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and the supporting cloud and AI tooling that backs WRITER's high-traffic platform. AI in workflow. Run agents in your daily loop — Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills — to investigate incidents, draft Terraform / Helm changes, write runbooks, scaffold tooling, and review PRs. Build the agentic setup as a collective surface: humans and digital teammates working as one team, with shared skills, shared context, and shared on-call workflows. Encode recurring infra tasks as internal skills any teammate (human or agent) can pick up and run, so the team's throughput compounds — not just your own. Debugging fluency. Lead incident response, post-mortems, and root-cause analyses — trace failures to the underlying problem (never the symptom), apply the learning back into the architecture, and prevent the same incident from happening twice. Non-technical End-to-end ownership. Own the reliability, performance, and efficiency of WRITER's core services end-to-end — define and uphold the SLOs and error budgets, carry the on-call pager, and stand behind the outcome metric, not just the system you shipped. Strategic vs. tactical balance. Balance this week's critical work with the 6–12-month platform direction — ship the on-call-driving fix today while shaping the multi-year observability, cost, and reliability investments that move WRITER's enterprise customers. Cross-functional collaboration. Operate at the seams with product, security, and engineering peers — provide expert guidance on system design for reliability, performance, and scalability from conception through launch, Connect the infra agenda to product and revenue context, and disagree with evidence, not volume. ⭐️ What You Need Technical Track record. 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a similar role focused on building and operating large-scale, high-availability production systems at a high-growth product company. Breadth. Experience running containerisation in production (a real cluster, not a lab), with experience in Helm and Terraform or Pulumi on at least one major cloud (AWS preferred), plus good proficiency in Python or Go for automation and tooling. AI in workflow. AI is part of how you ship, not a thing you've read about — agentic tooling (Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills) is in your daily loop, you've built or adopted AI-assisted workflows others now use, and you have strong opinions on where it's unreliable. This is a hard requirement, not a bonus. Candidates whose actual daily workflow does not already include AI tooling will not be advanced. First-principles + decision-making. Demonstrated ability to Challenge the status quo, proactively identify systemic weaknesses, and propose innovative solutions to complex reliability problems — reason from constraints and failure modes (not analogy or vendor defaults), name the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off), and reject the "best practices" answer when it doesn't fit the problem. Reversibility & blast-radius. Make reversible calls by default — write the rollback before you touch production, work fluently with monitoring and logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or equivalent), and stress the system in safe places so it comes back stronger. Non-technical Cross-functional collaboration. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a talent for building strong relationships and Connecting with cross-functional teams — surface non-goals before anyone asks, and partner with product, security, and platform peers as one delivery surface. Autonomy & end-to-end ownership. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, eager to Own mission-critical systems and drive them toward peak performance and unparalleled reliability. At least one 0-to-1 infrastructure build you owned end-to-end, with the outcome metric attached. 🎁 Bonus if you have Software-engineering depth. A software-engineering background, not only config and scripting — you've designed, built, and shipped non-trivial production code (services, libraries, internal frameworks) in Python, Go, or a comparable language, you can read and modify the codebases your infrastructure runs, and you move between infra automation and feature engineering without changing brains. 🍩 Benefits & Perks (UK Full-time Employees) Generous PTO, plus company holidays Comprehensive medical and dental insurance Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) Fertility and family planning support Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri Competitive pension scheme and company contribution Annual work-life stipends for: Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. Learning and development stipend Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites Competitive compensation and company stock options

A Day in the Life We’re looking for a Staff Engineer DevOps to join our Platform Engineering & Operations team as a hands-on individual-contributor engineer, helping to build and maintain the infrastructure underneath Lendistry’s lending platform. You’ll work on cloud architecture, security posture, and developer experience across a regulated financial services environment — and help support fellow engineers so we can grow without compromising reliability or compliance. As a certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and Community Development Entity (CDE), our mission is all about creating economic opportunities and fueling growth for small business owners and their communities. What You’ll Be Doing Collaboration & Mentorship Work as a hands-on individual contributor engineer on the Platform Engineering & Operations team, without formal people-management responsibilities. Help mentor junior engineers on the team, sharing knowledge as they grow their skills. Provide input and feedback on the technical roadmap for infrastructure and platform engineering. Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Support cloud architecture and account management across development, staging, and production environments for a regulated lending platform. Help implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices across infrastructure operations. Support container orchestration across multiple deployable services and cloud accounts. Security, Identity & Compliance Support identity management, account-level security posture, secrets management, and KMS key practices. Assist security and compliance teams with audits and vendor/security assessments for a regulated financial services platform. Developer Experience & CI/CD Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines across multiple repositories, from build through environment-gated production deployments. Support developer experience and internal tooling improvements for engineering teams. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in on-call and incident-response practices, including postmortems, for a platform where downtime directly impacts loan funding and servicing. AI-Native Platform Engineering Explore and help integrate AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into infrastructure workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and internal tooling. Support the adoption of AI-driven observability practices — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis — layered on top of existing monitoring stacks. Contribute to self-service internal tooling and golden paths that make it easier for engineers to ship safely. Substantial hands-on experience with public cloud platform services such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. Hands-on coding experience in at least two programming languages (Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, or .NET/C#). Experience with cloud-native application patterns and tools, microservices architectures, and application migrations to any cloud platform. Working understanding of infrastructure, virtualization, containers, networking, storage, and monitoring and logging/analytics tools (e.g., Splunk). Experience with application performance management tools (Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, etc.). Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and processes (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Ansible). Experience with developer tools and open-source technologies. Working familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps concepts and the infrastructure needs of AI/ML workloads (GPU or accelerator provisioning, model serving, inference cost and latency management). Hands-on use of AI coding assistants and developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in real engineering workflows. Familiarity with policy-as-code (e.g., OPA, Kyverno) and software supply chain security practices (SBOM generation, artifact signing/provenance) as applied to CI/CD pipelines. Preferred Expertise 2+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with hands-on experience in AWS production environments. Experience supporting cloud platforms aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework, with an interest in security, reliability, operational excellence, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. Hands-on experience with AWS core services, including VPC, EC2, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, S3, networking, security services, and container orchestration platforms such as Amazon EKS or ECS. Experience working with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or AWS CloudFormation. Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins. Experience with cloud operations, including platform administration, production support, capacity planning, patching, and maintenance for AWS environments. Experience working with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and New Relic to support platform health, performance, and availability. Ability to participate as a technical escalation point during production incidents, supporting incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews. Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including service reliability, SLAs/SLOs, incident management, change management, and operational readiness. Understanding of cloud cost optimization strategies, including resource right-sizing, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, storage lifecycle policies, and automation to improve operational efficiency and reduce cloud spend. Experience supporting DevSecOps practices, including automated security scanning, policy validation, compliance checks, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation within CI/CD pipelines. Good troubleshooting, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, security, operations, and platform teams. Interest in mentoring junior engineers and contributing to cloud engineering best practices is a plus. Interest in AI model governance and model-risk considerations (explainability, monitoring for drift/bias) in the context of AI-assisted decisioning within a regulated financial services environment. One part of that is the market data, pricing, and analytics services that thousands of firms rely on to make decisions every day. That means the platform needs to be reliable, resilient, and fast, day in and day out. Keeping it that way takes a global operations team that follows the sun: as one region logs off, the next picks it up. This seat is on the Atlanta desk. You will live close to production: understanding how our platforms perform and stepping in when something needs attention. We focus on automating work and reducing toil, sharpening the tooling and runbooks the whole team leans on. You will use AI tools to move faster and do more with less, judging a model's output rather than trusting it. This role suits people who would rather fix a problem for good than handle it twice. Responsibilities Keep production healthy: tuned in to the environment; you step in before a small anomaly turns into an incident. Own incidents end to end: coordinate the fix across engineering and partners, and drive a real root cause response, not a quick patch. Automate repetitive operational work with scripting and AI tools, so the team does less of it manually over time. Improve observability, tune monitoring, expose telemetry and drive intelligent alerting Help run recovery tabletop exercises and disaster recovery drills. Knowledge And Experience 3+ years with production systems, a relevant degree and certifications, or a track record of building and fixing things on your own. Fluency with AI and prompting to work smarter, with the judgment to check what you are handed. Familiarity with Git and version control.
